tagline: A celebration of love and forever.
story: Every great love story begins with a simple hello. What started as a chance meeting became a beautiful journey filled with laughter, adventures and endless memories.

events.name: Mehendi
events.description: The Mehendi ceremony is a vibrant and joyous pre-wedding ritual where intricate henna designs are applied to the bride's hands and feet. The event is filled with music, dance, and laughter as family and friends come together to celebrate this special occasion.

events.name: Sangeet
events.description: Dance the night away with us at our Sangeet ceremony!

events.name: Gaye Holud/Haldi
events.description: The Gaye Holud, also known as the Haldi ceremony, is a vibrant and auspicious pre-wedding ritual celebrated in Bengali weddings. During this ceremony, turmeric paste is applied to the bride and groom's bodies.

events.name: Wedding
events.venue: Army Officers Institute, Sangam, Vijay Durg
events.description: Join us for our wedding ceremony as we exchange vows and celebrate our love surrounded by family and friends
